themes_detail.label: Park Noise Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints from parks in Greenwich Village/SoHo spiked to 42 complaints last week versus a baseline of 4.1 per week—a 918% increase with z-score 12.55—signaling a sudden, severe deterioration in park conditions that warrants immediate investigation into what changed.
evidence: 42 park noise complaints last week vs. 4.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (918% spike, z-score 12.55)
Single largest statistical anomaly in dataset with highest z-score, indicating unprecedented deviation
Timing suggests sudden change rather than seasonal pattern, demanding explanation
reporting_angles: What specific events or conditions triggered the massive surge in park noise last week? (concerts, street performers, construction, enforcement gaps)
Interview park-adjacent residents and Community Board 2 about quality-of-life impact and whether parks are becoming unusable

themes_detail.label: Illegal Cannabis Retailers Emerging
themes_detail.summary: This week, 6 complaints about illegal cannabis retailers appeared versus a baseline of 0.9 per week—a 586% spike—indicating a sudden proliferation of unlicensed shops that city enforcement may be failing to monitor in the district.
evidence: 6 cannabis retailer complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly average (586% spike, z-score 6.57)
Second-highest z-score in dataset, indicating statistically severe anomaly
Greenwich Village/SoHo is high-foot-traffic retail zone where illegal shops would be visible and verifiable
reporting_angles: Map and count the illegal cannabis retailers operating this week in CD102; are they clustered in specific blocks?
Interview residents and small business owners about how unlicensed retailers are operating openly and what enforcement looks like

themes_detail.label: Construction Surge & Code Violations
themes_detail.summary: This week saw 34 general construction/plumbing complaints versus a 12.8 weekly average—a 167% increase—paired with 6 illegal tree damage complaints THIS WEEK versus 1.2 baseline, suggesting a construction boom with inadequate oversight and environmental safeguards.
evidence: 34 construction/plumbing complaints THIS WEEK vs. 12.8 weekly average (167% spike, z-score 4.82)
6 illegal tree damage complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.2 weekly average (380% spike, z-score 5.73)
1,730 DOB filings in last 90 days (1,502 alteration permits) indicate heavy construction activity district-wide
reporting_angles: Cross-reference 1,730 recent DOB filings with tree damage and construction complaints—are specific projects causing violations?
Investigate whether Department of Environmental Protection and Parks enforcement is keeping pace with construction activity

themes_detail.label: Dead Animals & Environmental Decay
themes_detail.summary: This week brought 3 dead animal complaints versus a 0.6 weekly baseline—a 380% spike—coinciding with 3 dead/dying tree complaints two weeks ago (700% spike), suggesting emerging environmental/sanitation conditions that merit investigation.
evidence: 3 dead animal complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average (380% spike, z-score 4.91)
3 dead/dying tree complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.4 weekly average (700% spike, z-score 5.42)
Temporal clustering suggests possible common cause (disease, environmental stress, or neglected public spaces)
reporting_angles: What is causing the spike in dead animals this week? Is there a disease outbreak or food waste management problem?
Have Parks Department and Sanitation inspected the tree die-off from 2 weeks ago and identified root causes?

themes_detail.label: Encampment & Public Drinking Issues
themes_detail.summary: Public drinking complaints surged 500% two weeks ago (3 vs. 0.5 baseline), and encampments remain a chronic top-10 complaint (441 over 90 days), signaling a sustained homelessness and substance use crisis in the district requiring longitudinal investigation.
evidence: 3 public drinking complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly average (500% spike, z-score 5.0)
441 encampment complaints over 90 days—consistent top-10 complaint category indicating chronic issue
Combined signal suggests interconnected homelessness, mental health, and public safety challenge
reporting_angles: Profile the encampment hotspots in Greenwich Village/SoHo—which blocks have repeat complaints and what services are available?
Interview residents, business owners, and homeless outreach workers about the relationship between drinking and encampment complaints
